Home.title: Habinox · Made-to-measure stainless steel metalwork
Home.description: Stainless steel specialists since 2005, in Antas, Esposende. Made-to-measure stairs, gates, railings and chimneys.

company.title: In Antas, Esposende, since 2005.
company.lead: We started with stainless steel. Today we work in stainless steel, welded aluminium and iron, with a focus on modernisation and innovation.

how.title: From cutting to polishing.
how.lead: 2D and 3D design, site preparation and execution, with our own equipment:
items: Sheet metal cutting and bending line
CNC cutting, like the railings on this staircase
how.photoAlt: Spiral staircase with CNC-cut railings and illuminated steps

steel.title: Beautiful and built to last.
steel.lead: Long life cycle and low maintenance cost: a beautiful, economical choice for architecture and construction.

near.title: We come to the site with you.
items: The whole country, and we manufacture for Europe

contacts.title: Get in touch.
contacts.address: Núcleo Industrial de Antas, 4740-016 Antas, Esposende
contacts.hours: Weekdays, 9:00–18:30. Calls charged at national landline / mobile rates.
